description: Manage users, roles, groups, organizations, applications (OAuth clients), API keys, invitations and custom domains of a TrustPort Identity tenant.  Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <token>` where the token is either a user access token or a **secret API key** (`sk_live_…` / `sk_test_…`). Single objects are wrapped as `{ "data": ... }`; the users list also carries paging fields at the top level.
